bio: Delhi-based graphic designer and National Institute of Design, Ahmedabad graduate who began developing her first typeface during a 2013 internship at the Indian Type Foundry. Designed Tarsus, a Latin-script text serif typeface optimized for demanding print environments including newsprint, published by ITF in 2015. Known for stippled scientific typography and 3D visual work published in outlets including Wired.

sources.title: Khyati Trehan — Indian Type Foundry designer profile
